tbesh_html:
1) heel, rear, footprint, hinder part, hoof, rear of a troop, footstep
1a) heel
1b) mark of heel, footprint
1c) hinder part, rear

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a heel (as protuberant); hence, a track; figuratively, the rear (of an army)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: heel, (horse-) hoof, last, lier in wait (by mistake for H6120 (עָקֵב)), (foot-) step.
